title: AI Developer Needed for AI-Powered Candidate Matching Platform
description:
Project: AI-Powered Candidate Matching Platform for IT Recruitment

Background
I am an IT Recruitment Consultant with approximately four years of experience and a personal database of around 1,500 IT candidates I have interviewed.
For each candidate, I have a CV and an interview report containing information about their technical skills, professional experience, career preferences, motivations, salary expectations, and other relevant details.
I want to build a private AI-powered application that allows me to find the best candidates from my existing network whenever I receive a new vacancy from a client.
Instead of manually searching through folders and documents, I want to upload a vacancy and automatically receive a ranked shortlist of the most relevant candidates from my database.

What I Want to Build
1. Candidate Database and Document Processing
• Upload CVs in PDF and Word formats.
• Upload interview reports and link them to the correct candidate.
• Automatically extract relevant information from both documents.
• Identify technical skills, work experience, seniority, certifications, salary expectations, location, availability, and career preferences.
• Store the extracted information in a structured and searchable database.
• Support adding new candidates and updating existing profiles.

2. AI-Powered Vacancy Analysis
I want to upload a vacancy as a PDF, Word document, or text.
The AI should understand the vacancy and identify mandatory requirements, preferred qualifications, technical skills, experience requirements, seniority, location, and other relevant criteria.

3. Intelligent Candidate Matching
This is the most important part of the project.
After uploading a vacancy, the application should search my entire candidate database and generate a ranked shortlist of the top 5, 10, or 20 candidates.
The matching process should consider:
• Technical skills and relevant experience.
• Similar roles and transferable skills.
• Mandatory requirements versus preferred qualifications.
• Seniority and industry experience.
• Salary expectations, availability, and location, where relevant.
I do not want simple keyword matching. The system should understand the context of the vacancy and the information in the candidates' CVs and interview reports.
For every recommended candidate, I want to see:
• A match score.
• Relevant experience and skills.
• The reasons why the candidate matches the vacancy.
• Missing requirements or potential concerns.
• Supporting information from the original documents.
The results should be based on actual candidate information, not assumptions generated by the AI.

4. Natural-Language Search
I would also like to search my database using natural language.
For example:
• Find experienced Azure engineers who have worked for IT service providers.
• Find IT Support Engineers with Microsoft 365 and Active Directory experience.
• Find ERP consultants with implementation experience.
The system should identify relevant candidates even when the exact words used in the search do not appear in their documents.

5. User Interface and Export
I want a clean, intuitive web application that I can use independently.
The basic workflow should be:
1. Upload candidate documents.
2. Upload a new vacancy.
3. Generate a ranked shortlist.
4. Review candidate profiles and match explanations.
5. Export the shortlist to Excel or CSV.
The application should be easy to maintain and allow me to add new candidates without requiring a developer for routine tasks.

Technical Skills Required
I am looking for a developer with demonstrable experience in:
• Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models (LLMs).
• Semantic Search and Information Retrieval.
• Natural Language Processing (NLP).
• Document Parsing and Data Extraction.
• Vector Databases and Embeddings.
• Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), where appropriate.
• Hybrid Search and Ranking Systems.
• Backend and Web Application Development.
• Database Design and Data Security.
I am open to your recommendations regarding the technology stack. Possible technologies include Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, and suitable LLM services.
Please explain your proposed architecture and why you believe it is appropriate for this project.

Privacy and Data Security
The application will eventually process real candidate information, so privacy and security are essential.
I want to start with fictitious candidate data for development and testing.
Before introducing real candidate data, the data processing arrangements, security measures, and applicable legal requirements must be reviewed.
Please explain how you would protect candidate data, manage external AI services, and support GDPR compliance.

How I Prefer to Work
I value clear communication, realistic expectations, and transparent pricing.
I would prefer to develop this project in stages rather than commit to a large implementation immediately.
The first step should be a working prototype using fictitious candidate profiles and vacancies. This will allow us to evaluate the matching quality before proceeding with the complete application.
Please distinguish between the cost of the prototype and the estimated cost of the full application.
I would also like regular progress updates and demonstrations of working functionality throughout development.

Expected Deliverables
• A working web application.
• Candidate database and document processing.
• AI-powered vacancy analysis.
• Ranked candidate matching with supporting explanations.
• Natural-language search and filtering.
• Excel or CSV export.
• Secure authentication and appropriate access controls.
• Complete source code and technical documentation.
• Deployment instructions and a handover session.
I expect to own the custom-developed application and receive the source code, subject to the applicable terms of any third-party software and services.

Questions for Applicants (in the description)
Please answer the following questions in your proposal:
1. Have you built a semantic search, document intelligence, or AI-powered matching application before? Please share relevant examples.
2. How would you approach matching approximately 1,500 candidates, each with a CV and an interview report, against new vacancies?
3. How would you ensure that mandatory requirements and actual qualifications influence the ranking, rather than relying solely on semantic similarity?
4. What technology stack would you recommend, and why?
5. How would you test the quality of the matching results?
6. How would you protect candidate information when using external AI services?
7. What would your proposed timeline and estimated cost be for the prototype and the complete application?

I am looking for a developer who can help turn this idea into a practical, reliable tool that improves how I use my existing candidate network.
